# Read in data and load libraries 
```{r}
library(car)
library(tidyverse)
library(emmeans)
library(agricolae)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
d <- read.csv("../data/LegacyDryWeights2025.csv") %>% 
  filter(., Shoot_g != "NA")
d$Reinc <- gsub("CK", "N", d$Reinc)
d$Density <- gsub("L", "Low", d$Density)
d$Density <- gsub("M", "Medium", d$Density)
d$Density <- gsub("H", "High", d$Density)
d$Reinc <- gsub("N", "None", d$Reinc)
d$Reinc <- gsub("R", "Root", d$Reinc)
d$Reinc <- gsub("S", "Shoot_", d$Reinc)

d <- d %>%
mutate(Density = as_factor(Density)) %>%
mutate(Density = fct_relevel(Density, "CK", "Low", "Medium", "High"))
par(mfrow=c(2,2))

# Check reincorporation groups
unique(d$Reinc)

# Check number of observations in each group
table(d$Reinc)

# Check treatments within each reincorporation group
table(d$Reinc, d$Legume_Var, d$Density)

```

# NO REINCORPORATION

```{r}

d.none <- d %>%
  filter(Reinc == "None") %>%
  mutate(Var_Density = paste(Legume_Var, Density, sep = "_"),
         Var_Density = factor(Var_Density,
           levels = c("CK_CK",
                      "An_Low", "An_Medium", "An_High",
                      "Cal_Low", "Cal_Medium", "Cal_High",
                      "Va_Low", "Va_Medium", "Va_High")))

table(d.none$Var_Density)

# Model
mod.none <- lm(Shoot_g ~ Var_Density, data = d.none)

# Model diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(mod.none)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ANOVA
car::Anova(mod.none, type = 2)

# Estimated marginal means
emm.none <- emmeans::emmeans(mod.none, ~ Var_Density)
print(emm.none)

# Pairwise comparisons - FDR
pairs.none <- pairs(emm.none, adjust = "fdr")
print(pairs.none)

# Significance letters
groups.none <- data.frame(
  multcomp::cld(emm.none, adjust = "fdr",
                Letters = letters, decreasing = TRUE)
) %>%
  select(Var_Density, .group) %>%
  rename(letters = .group) %>%
  mutate(letters = gsub(" ", "", letters))

print(groups.none)

# Mean, SD and SE
df.none <- d.none %>%
  group_by(Var_Density) %>%
  summarise(response = mean(Shoot_g, na.rm = TRUE),
            SD = sd(Shoot_g, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(Shoot_g)),
            SE = SD / sqrt(n),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(groups.none, by = "Var_Density")

print(df.none[, c("Var_Density", "n", "response", "SE", "letters")])

# Figure
p_none <- ggplot(df.none,
  aes(x = Var_Density, y = response, fill = Var_Density)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = response - SE, ymax = response + SE),
                width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(y = response + SE + 0.40, label = letters),
            size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, color = "gray60") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("CK_CK" = "darkorchid3",
               "An_Low" = "firebrick1",
               "An_Medium" = "firebrick3",
               "An_High" = "firebrick4",
               "Cal_Low" = "goldenrod1",
               "Cal_Medium" = "goldenrod",
               "Cal_High" = "goldenrod4",
               "Va_Low" = "deepskyblue",
               "Va_Medium" = "deepskyblue3",
               "Va_High" = "darkblue"),
    drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c("CK_CK" = "Control",
               "An_Low" = "Anasazi Low",
               "An_Medium" = "Anasazi Medium",
               "An_High" = "Anasazi High",
               "Cal_Low" = "California-5 Low",
               "Cal_Medium" = "California-5 Medium",
               "Cal_High" = "California-5 High",
               "Va_Low" = "Vail Low",
               "Va_Medium" = "Vail Medium",
               "Va_High" = "Vail High")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 8)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Shoot Biomass (g)") +
  ggtitle("No Reincorporation") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

p_none
```


# ROOT REINCORPORATION

```{r}
d.root <- d %>%
  filter(Reinc == "Root" |
           (Legume_Var == "CK" & Density == "CK")) %>%
  mutate(Var_Density = paste(Legume_Var, Density, sep = "_"),
         Var_Density = factor(Var_Density,
           levels = c("CK_CK",
                      "An_Low", "An_Medium", "An_High",
                      "Cal_Low", "Cal_Medium", "Cal_High",
                      "Va_Low", "Va_Medium", "Va_High")))

table(d.root$Var_Density)

# Model
mod.root <- lm(Shoot_g ~ Var_Density, data = d.root)

# Model diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(mod.root)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# ANOVA
car::Anova(mod.root, type = 2)

# Estimated marginal means
emm.root <- emmeans::emmeans(mod.root, ~ Var_Density)
print(emm.root)

# Pairwise comparisons - FDR
pairs.root <- pairs(emm.root, adjust = "fdr")
print(pairs.root)

# Significance letters
groups.root <- data.frame(
  multcomp::cld(emm.root, adjust = "fdr",
                Letters = letters, decreasing = TRUE)
) %>%
  select(Var_Density, .group) %>%
  rename(letters = .group) %>%
  mutate(letters = gsub(" ", "", letters))

print(groups.root)

# Mean, SD and SE
df.root <- d.root %>%
  group_by(Var_Density) %>%
  summarise(response = mean(Shoot_g, na.rm = TRUE),
            SD = sd(Shoot_g, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(Shoot_g)),
            SE = SD / sqrt(n),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(groups.root, by = "Var_Density")

print(df.root[, c("Var_Density", "n", "response", "SE", "letters")])

# Figure
p_root <- ggplot(df.root,
  aes(x = Var_Density, y = response, fill = Var_Density)) +

  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = response - SE, ymax = response + SE),
                width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 1) +

            size = 6, fontface = "bold") +

    values = c("CK_CK" = "darkorchid3",
               "An_Low" = "firebrick1",
               "An_Medium" = "firebrick3",
               "An_High" = "firebrick4",
               "Cal_Low" = "goldenrod1",
               "Cal_Medium" = "goldenrod",
               "Cal_High" = "goldenrod4",
               "Va_Low" = "deepskyblue",
               "Va_Medium" = "deepskyblue3",
               "Va_High" = "darkblue"),
    drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c("CK_CK" = "Control",
               "An_Low" = "Anasazi Low",
               "An_Medium" = "Anasazi Medium",
               "An_High" = "Anasazi High",
               "Cal_Low" = "California-5 Low",
               "Cal_Medium" = "California-5 Medium",
               "Cal_High" = "California-5 High",
               "Va_Low" = "Vail Low",
               "Va_Medium" = "Vail Medium",
               "Va_High" = "Vail High")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 8)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Shoot Biomass (g)") +
  ggtitle("Root Reincorporation") +
  theme_classic() +

        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
```

# SHOOT BIOMASS ANALYSIS: SHOOT-ROOT REINCORPORATION

```{r}

d.sr <- d %>%
  filter(Reinc == "Shoot_Root" | (Legume_Var == "CK" & Density == "CK")) %>%
  mutate(Var_Density = paste(Legume_Var, Density, sep = "_"),
         Var_Density = factor(Var_Density,
           levels = c("CK_CK",
                      "An_Low", "An_Medium", "An_High",
                      "Cal_Low", "Cal_Medium", "Cal_High",
                      "Va_Low", "Va_Medium", "Va_High")))

# Check observations per treatment
table(d.sr$Var_Density)

# 2. Statistical model
mod.sr <- lm(Shoot_g ~ Var_Density, data = d.sr)

# 3. Model diagnostics
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(mod.sr)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# 4. ANOVA
car::Anova(mod.sr, type = 2)

# 5. Estimated marginal means
emm.sr <- emmeans::emmeans(mod.sr, ~ Var_Density)
print(emm.sr)

# 6. Pairwise comparisons (FDR adjustment)
pairs.sr <- pairs(emm.sr, adjust = "fdr")
print(pairs.sr)

# 7. Significance letters
groups.sr <- data.frame(
  multcomp::cld(emm.sr, adjust = "fdr",
                 Letters = letters, decreasing = TRUE)
) %>%
  select(Var_Density, .group) %>%
  rename(letters = .group) %>%
  mutate(letters = gsub(" ", "", letters))

print(groups.sr)

# 8. Mean, SD and SE for figure
df.sr <- d.sr %>%
  group_by(Var_Density) %>%
  summarise(response = mean(Shoot_g, na.rm = TRUE),
            SD = sd(Shoot_g, na.rm = TRUE),
            n = sum(!is.na(Shoot_g)),
            SE = SD / sqrt(n),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(groups.sr, by = "Var_Density")

# Check figure values
print(df.sr[, c("Var_Density", "n", "response", "SE", "letters")])

# 9. Figure
p_sr <- ggplot(df.sr,
  aes(x = Var_Density, y = response, fill = Var_Density)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = response - SE, ymax = response + SE),
                width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(y = response + SE + 0.40, label = letters),
            size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1.5, color = "gray60") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("CK_CK" = "darkorchid3",
               "An_Low" = "firebrick1",
               "An_Medium" = "firebrick3",
               "An_High" = "firebrick4",
               "Cal_Low" = "goldenrod1",
               "Cal_Medium" = "goldenrod",
               "Cal_High" = "goldenrod4",
               "Va_Low" = "deepskyblue",
               "Va_Medium" = "deepskyblue3",
               "Va_High" = "darkblue"),
    drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c("CK_CK" = "Control",
               "An_Low" = "Anasazi Low",
               "An_Medium" = "Anasazi Medium",
               "An_High" = "Anasazi High",
               "Cal_Low" = "California-5 Low",
               "Cal_Medium" = "California-5 Medium",
               "Cal_High" = "California-5 High",
               "Va_Low" = "Vail Low",
               "Va_Medium" = "Vail Medium",
               "Va_High" = "Vail High")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 8)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Shoot Biomass (g)") +
  ggtitle("Shoot-Root Reincorporation") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 14,
                                   face = "bold", angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 14,
                                   face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

# Display figure
p_sr
```

# Combine the three panels

```{r}
p_shoot <- (p_none / p_root / p_sr) +
  plot_layout(
    guides = "collect",
    axes = "collect"
  )

# Show figure
p_shoot

# Save figure
ggsave(filename = "figs/shoot2.png", plot = p_shoot, width = 10, height = 12,dpi = 600)
```

```{r}
               "Cal_Medium" = "goldenrod",
               "Cal_High" = "goldenrod4",
               "Va_Low" = "deepskyblue",
               "Va_Medium" = "deepskyblue3",
               "Va_High" = "darkblue"),
    drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE,
    labels = c("CK_CK" = "Control",
               "An_Low" = "Anasazi Low",
               "An_Medium" = "Anasazi Medium",
               "An_High" = "Anasazi High",
               "Cal_Low" = "California-5 Low",
               "Cal_Medium" = "California-5 Medium",
               "Cal_High" = "California-5 High",
               "Va_Low" = "Vail Low",
               "Va_Medium" = "Vail Medium",
               "Va_High" = "Vail High")) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 10)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Root Biomass (g)") +
  ggtitle("Shoot-Root Reincorporation") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 14,
                                   face = "bold", angle = 90, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

p_sr_root
```
